requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The customer should see only one consistent product name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to prevent user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate reliably and meet intervention specifications for all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types under various climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function correctly and without hardware failures (e.g., input tray sensor flag) when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failures when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing, as per CISS product evaluation protocol.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when printing while placed on a trolley.
